# Review — cid-tiradas-131-131 (vv. 2763–2862b, tirada 131)

Checked: every unit's `t`/`l`/`i`/`n` (36 units) against the pinned packet and conventions.md; the scan, PDF pp. 305–309
(printed 301–305), read on the image at zoom 1.4 with a zoom-2.2 strip of p. 304 (2824b–2839), including the rubric
of 131 and every Pidal footnote on these pages (2763, 2767, 2779, 2781, 2783, 2804, 2809, 2812, 2822, 2828, 2833,
2838, 2839, 2843, 2851, 2856). Every quotation of Pidal in the notes was compared with the print letter by letter
(the 2338 note, quoted at 2797, from the published 115–117 note). Cross-references checked in the published parts:
vv. 248, 907, 1663, 1889, 2338, 2388, 2476, 2477, 2577, 2618, 2693, 2707–2711, 2720, 2725, 2746, 2748, 2757; house
renderings checked against 102–130 (`i` uses "my Çid", "Valencia the great", "the worthy man of Burgos", "San
Esteban", "May God in heaven …" for *Afé Dios del çielo que …*, *pagados* "well pleased/content").

The rubric matches the print. The `t` fields joined by "\n" equal the packet's 103 verses in order; no `t` was
changed; every `l` has as many lines as its `t`; no unit is over 4 lines (verified by script after editing).

## Pass 1: units.json

1. 2763 · n · weak. "echoing ívanse alabando at the end of the last": v. 2757 is the fourth of the nine lines of
   tirada 130 (2754–2762), not its end. Now "echoing v. 2757 in the tirada before (Por los montes do ivan, ellos
   ívanse alabando)".
2. 2772–2774 · i · weak. *ni dend sabien ración* was "nor knew the least thing of him"; *dend* is 'of it' (and `l`
   says "of-it"). Now "of it".
3. 2783–2785 · n · style. The note said the *de* of *tanto son de traspuestas* "has no English counterpart" while `l`
   renders it "of". Now: idiomatic ('so far gone are they'), kept as 'of' in the literal line. (Ruling on the flag:
   the reading stands; no note from Pidal.)
4. 2796–2798 · i · weak. *Tan a grant duelo* lost its *tan* ("In great grief"), and "As our father … may repay you"
   is not English for the optative *sí*. Now "In such great grief Doña Sol spoke: “So may our father the Campeador
   repay you for it, my cousin: give us some water, so may the Creator help you.”"
5. 2796–2798 · n · style. Ruling on the flag *sí vos lo meresca*: merecer 'repay' with *nuestro padre* as subject is
   right (cf. v. 2338). Pidal's gloss there ('ojalá os lo pueda pagar con creces') now cited, and the subject named.
6. 2799–2802 · n · style. Ruling on *Valençial*: Valençia + enclitic object pronoun for the hat, repeating the
   relative *que*. The note had only "l(e)"; now "le, or lo cut to l", the paraphrase = que lo sacó de Valençia
   (the gloss entry had "lo"; the two now agree).
7. 2820–2823 · n · style. The English of Pidal's note to 2822 dropped "que los de San Esteban dan a las hijas del
   Cid" and "v. 2814"; completed. *sabien* "imperfect, 'they learned'" → "imperfect where a preterite might be
   expected, 'when they came to know'".
8. 2836–2838 · l · style. *quales* "such-as" → "those-whom" (Pidal, note to 2838: 'los que'), matching the note
   and `i`.
9. 2841–2844 · n · style. Pidal's note to 2843 ends "V. pág. 100."; the quotation stopped before it. Now said that
   he adds 'V. pág. 100', a reference to his introduction.

Checked and confirmed, no change (rulings on the drafter's flags included):
- **2784 *tanto son de traspuestas*** — see 3; *traspuesto* 'senseless' from context and Pidal's note to 2783.
- **2812 *don Urraca*** — the text prints *don*, Pidal's note to 2812 prints *doña Urraca* (italic); "Doña Urraca" in
  `i`, as don Elvira → Doña Elvira. The note's quotation of 2812 is exact.
- **2814 *Dí[a]g Téllez … el que de Albar Fáñez f[o]*** "Álvar Fáñez's man": right; Pidal (note to 2822) calls him
  'vasallo o pechero de Albar Fáñez'.
- **2822 note, '2840' → 2849**: verified. The word *enffurçión* is on the line Pidal's margin would number 2849
  (labels 2845 at *A Sant Estevan*, 2850 at *non gelo quiso*); his '(igual en 2840)' is a misprint. The note says so.
- **2824b**: on p. 304 the wholly italic line *Por todas essas tierras …* has no number in the margin; the next line
  carries 2825 (and 2830 follows five lines later). So the letter b is ours, as the note says; the note says it
  correctly (not "Pidal's 2824b").
- **2825 *peso* = pesó**: the print has *peso* without accent (checked at zoom 2.2); the note says so.
- **2839–2841 numbering**: verified on p. 304. Labels 2835 *Pesó*, 2835b *e Albar Fáñez*, then the label 2840
  stands against *Non lo detardan*, the sixth line after 2835b; footnotes 2838 (*quales*), 2839 (*les dijo
  encarecidamente*) and 2843 (*Gormaz*) and the label 2845 on p. 305 fix *aduxiessen* as 2840 and *Non lo
  detardan* as 2841. The note's explanation is right.
- **2835b, 2862b**: both printed by Pidal in the margin; "Pidal's own number" is right.
- **2789 supplied closing ”**: the print ends *mont !* with no quotation mark; the speech ends there (2790 is
  narrative). Supplied, said in the note.
- **2855 *de* = dé, *Affé … que***: print *de*; optative 'may God give you', as *Afé Dios del çielo que …* at
  vv. 1940, 2154 ("May God in heaven …"). Right.
- **2856 *sos pagados son***: Pidal's note quoted exactly; "well pleased with him" agrees with v. 248 *so vuestro
  pagado* "well content with you".
- **2773 *ración***: 'portion' → 'nothing at all', from context, said to be without a note from Pidal. Kept; uncertain.
- **2810 *entre noch e día***: "by night and by day", with 'in the half-light' named as possible and the sense marked
  uncertain. Kept; no note from Pidal.
- **Footnote quotations**: 2763, 2767, 2779, 2781, 2783, 2804, 2809, 2812, 2822, 2828, 2833, 2838, 2839, 2843, 2851,
  2856 — all exact (inner quotes converted to double quotes as in earlier parts).
- **Grammar labels**: every person/number/tense/mood and every enclitic split checked (diré, viesse, vi[di]en,
  vi[d]iessen, escapara, plega, prendan, Despertedes, entre, coman, fallaren, seré buscado, morremos, meresca, vala,
  dandos, priso, sovieron, se[d]ían, andidiessen, aduxiessen, vinie, sodes, diestes, cuntió, estó, de = dé,
  viéssemos, gradid; doliól, mandáronle, Víolos, nol, Vansse, tornós, Valas, Partiéronsele, Esforçadvos, pesól,
  pesóles, danles, gelo, dixoles). All right.
- **Cross-references**: aguijan a espolón v. 2693; the company sent ahead vv. 2707–2711; mantles stripped v. 2720;
  don Dí[a]go v. 2725; telas del coraçón v. 2577; the beard gesture vv. 1663, 2476; Cristus v. 2477; una grant ora
  v. 1889; sovo v. 907; ensayarse v. 2388 — all right.
- **Remembered translation**: none found.

## Pass 2: gloss.json

1. ensayaron · error. "sense approximate, Pidal gives no note I rely on": Pidal's note to 2781 is 'mala proeza
   hicieron' (cf. 2388). Rewritten from it.
2. coñosçedores · error. 'grateful … = agradecidos', against Pidal's note to 2851 'entendido, prudente' and the unit
   ("men of good understanding"). Rewritten.
3. enffurçión · error. "Pidal's term", "due to a lord or guest", "no modern word": it is the poem's word, Pidal
   defines the tenant's tribute in kind to his lord (note to 2822), and modern Spanish has *infurción*. Rewritten.
4. lazradas · error. "= lacradas" (lacrar 'to seal with wax') is a wrong modern form; now "= laceradas".
5. ssus · error. Labelled 'their' with the example 'his daughters'; now 'his'.
6. __broaden__ tornando · error. The drafter's new sense 'turning to, tending … uncertain; = atendiéndolas' ignored
   Pidal's note to 2783 ('las va haciendo volver en su acuerdo'). Now 'bringing round, reviving'.
7. lograrán · weak. "sense from context, uncertain": Pidal's note to 2833 gives it. Rewritten from the note.
8. arrendó · weak. "sense from context": Pidal 'lo ató por la rienda' (note to 2779). Fixed.
9. valas · weak. Example 'he went on turning them (round, to them)' → 'he goes on bringing them round' with Pidal's
   gloss; *Valas conortando* added.
10. ración · weak. The unsourced guess "perhaps a spelling of razón" dropped; now as the unit, 'nothing at all',
    from context.
11. vidiessen · weak. 'if they were to see him' → 'if they had seen him' (pluperfect-conditional sense, as the unit).
12. urraca · weak. 'owner or founder of the tower' unsourced, and "Lady Urraca" against `i` "Doña Urraca": now
    Pidal's note to 2812 (La Torre, 7 km west of San Esteban de Gormaz, near the Llano de Urraca).
13. quales · weak. 'whom, such as … such as the Cid ordered' → 'those whom', Pidal 'los que'.
14. valençial · weak. 'elided lo' only; now le or lo, repeating the relative, as the unit.
15. __broaden__ meresca · weak. 'may he deserve / requite … sense approximate' → 'may he repay (it to you)', as the
    unit and v. 2338.
16. doliól · weak. "'his heart ached'" → 'his heart misgave him', with Pidal's note to 2767.
17. traspuestas · style. "traspõner" (stray tilde) → trasponer.
18. vidien, sabien · style. "-ié ending" → "-ie ending, printed unaccented".
19. conortando, dixoles, gormaz · style. Pidal's glosses added ('las va confortando'; 'les dijo
    encarecidamente'; the castle note to 2843); "near San Esteban" in gormaz dropped (not Pidal).
20. proes · style. "sense from context" dropped (pro 'worthy' is a known sense).
21. __broaden__ mal · weak (added). Known noun/adverb senses do not cover the adjective in *mal galardón*.
22. __broaden__ mont · weak (added). Known entry has only place names (Mont Mayor …); *en aqueste mont* 'in this wood'.
23. __broaden__ elle · weak (added). Known 'he' does not cover *en el[le]* 'in it' (2801), 'on him' (2859).
24. __broaden__ de · weak (added). *de* = dé (dar), 2855, and *tanto … de* + adjective, 2784.
25. __broaden__ fo · weak (added). *el que de Albar Fáñez fo* 'who was Álvar Fáñez's man' (ser de of a vassal).
26. __broaden__ fuertemientre · weak (added). Pidal 'les dijo encarecidamente' (note to 2839).
27. __broaden__ vala · style (added). Known example says 'may he keep you'; the house rendering is 'help'.
28. __broaden__ metió · style (added). *se metió* 'went into' and *dentro las metió* 'brought them inside'.

The drafter's broadens of *tornós*, *entre*, *ganados*, *vale*, *cavalgó*, *peso*, *tomar*, *verdad*, *fincan* are
correct (old entry kept whole). The rest of the 80 entries were checked against the form, the units and Pidal's
notes and found right. gloss.json parses; its keys equal the 80 novel-form tokens plus `__broaden__` (now 19), and
every broaden begins with the known entry exactly + " · also" (verified by script).

## Refused

- 2770–2771 *o que an fecho*: reading *o* as ó 'where' ('until he should see … where they have taken them'):
  'or what' is the plain sense, with *que* = qué. Kept.
- 2786 `i` "Wake while it is still day": "Wake" is added English, but needed to join the clause. Kept.
- 2797 `l` "may-repay" for *meresca*: literal 'deserve, earn (of you)' (as `l` at 2338 "I-may-earn") was considered;
  here the subject is a third person and the sense is plain repayment. Kept, with the citation added.
- 2809 `i` order ("… by night and by day, came out of the woods"): slightly heavy but faithful. Kept.
- *cubrió* lemma *cobrir*: an attested Old Spanish infinitive. Kept.
- *gelo* 'it from them' (non gelo quiso tomar), *sacó* 'brought (out)', *andan* 'travel', *dent* 'for it': close
  enough to the known entries; no broaden.
- Quoting Pidal's note to 2388 in the *ensayaron* gloss: not on these pages and not checked on the print, so only
  the cross-reference is given.

## Left uncertain

- *ración* (2773): 'nothing at all' from context; no note from Pidal.
- *entre noch e día* (2810): 'by night and by day' taken, 'in the half-light' possible; no note.
- *traspuestas* (2784) 'senseless', and the *de* of *tanto son de traspuestas*: from context and the note to 2783.
- Italic extent of vi[di]en (2773) and se[d]ían (2824), as the establishing run reported; not re-read at high zoom.
- *Valençial* (2800): le or lo cut to l; the sense is not in doubt.
